scope: Native QQTang main screens, common controls, room and shop UI

structuralAlphaInputs.purpose: Source segmented status silhouette; RGB is fully replaced

assumptions: Status-bar fixed slots visually match a needle, armor/guard and winged boot. Own images replace those visual roles; exact native inventory IDs and effects are not inferred.

assumptions.evidence: Source image captions are legible; exact path binding was not found in the four inspected inert UI modules.
Native PetInfo path binding is confirmed; its smile face is replaced by the existing original pet-card paw crop.

assumptions: Storage buttons retain normal/gray/highlight/pressed stored order; task step icons retain normal/highlight/pressed/gray order.
Task level indices retain their original order, with own gold, silver, red-crown, amethyst and rose artwork.
The practice selector uses two existing own portraits. Its two labels and native click rectangles retain their original functions.
The task detail background is rendered in original 430x532 coordinates, then cropped at the measured native raster (28,21,397,518).
Runtime NPC and reward item images are separate native resources and are not supplied by this background renderer.

operation: Existing original painted UI sliced and text rendered at native control dimensions, then encoded into original DIMG pixel modes.
